recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the current build source to match the approved FHIR-25037 naming and the existing Encounter-date-end canonical id while preserving the R5-published end-date query name as an alias.
issue_request: FHIR-25037 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request asking for Encounter start and end date search support and sorting for Encounter.actualPeriod. The accepted resolution specified adding date-start and date-end search parameters.
initial_application: Git commit 610257357ddcca8b07c65fc961702fa2cafca5f3 added Encounter.actualPeriod.start and Encounter.actualPeriod.end SearchParameter entries for FHIR-25037. The start parameter used Encounter-date-start/date-start, and the end parameter used Encounter-date-end for the id/url but end-date for SearchParameter.code, leaving the current source inconsistent with the Jira resolution and its own canonical name.
additional_context: The February 2020 PA/FHIR-I WGM minutes record the naming approach as using the same search parameter name with X-start or X-end for period boundaries, which makes the Encounter.date pair date-start/date-end. Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-34866 added SearchParameter.aliasCode and naming guidance for retaining backward-compatible aliases when standardizing search parameter names.
reconciliation: Changed source/encounter/bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml so Encounter-date-end has primary code date-end and aliasCode end-date. Updated source/compartments.xml so the Encounter row references date-end in the enddate column.
source_changes: source/encounter/bundle-Encounter-search-params.xml: changed Encounter-date-end SearchParameter.code from end-date to date-end and added aliasCode end-date.
source/compartments.xml: changed the Encounter enddate compartment search parameter reference from end-date to date-end.

related_jiras.note: Defines SearchParameter.aliasCode and naming-guideline support used to preserve the old end-date code while making date-end primary.

evidence_items.learned: For the existing Encounter date parameter, the intended boundary pair is date-start and date-end.

evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current source now exposes the approved primary code while preserving the previously published name as an alias.
